testcase.name: search content is data not a second instruction
arbitrary or chained instructions never execute
explicit tap and edit commands stay single actions
every documented gesture maps to the physical swipe direction
launcher command preserves full app name
punctuation and casing from speech recognizers are tolerated
search payload retains case and embedded punctuation
conjunctions are accepted only for exact installed app labels
navigation and cancellation use exact phrases
dictation preserves literal punctuation case and instructions
